record.question: Do not start till I give the word. Identify the part of speech of the underlined word.
record.explanation: Answer D: Conjunction. “Till” introduces the clause “I give the word”, so it is a conjunction. Independent check: “Till I give the word” introduces a subordinate time clause, so “till” is a conjunction here. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/till.
